subject.title: [Bug]: Tool stdout leaks to chat + reply generation interrupted

question: What boundary should OpenClaw enforce for command stdout in external chats, and when may replay-unsafe post-tool incomplete turns be retried?
rationale: Current behavior is partly documented debug output and partly a side-effect safety gate; changing either without maintainer intent could expose less diagnostic data than expected or duplicate tool actions.

options.title: Split policy and implementation
options.body: Keep this issue open, decide the stdout suppression boundary separately from the replay-unsafe retry policy, then implement narrow tests for the chosen cases.

options.title: Suppress all command stdout
options.body: Hide command output from external chats even under verbose full, accepting a breaking change to current debug behavior.

options.title: Retry replay-unsafe turns
options.body: Retry post-tool incomplete turns even when replay metadata is unsafe, accepting the risk of duplicated side effects.

recommendation.title: Split policy and implementation
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open, decide the stdout suppression boundary separately from the replay-unsafe retry policy, then implement narrow tests for the chosen cases.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced the verbose tool feedback surface and is the clearest owner for deciding whether documented verbose-full output should narrow for external chats.
